Based on their relative proportions and differential abundance testing (FDR 10%), we found activated CD4 + T cells expressing IL 22 , circulating follicular helper T (T FH ) cells, type 1 helper T (T H 1) cells, CD8 + effector memory T (T EM ) cells and MAIT cells relatively enriched in individuals with asymptomatic and mild infection, with NKT, proliferating CD8 + and CD4 + , and CD8 + terminal effector T (T TE ) cells enriched in individuals with more severe infection (Fig. 3e and Extended Data Fig. 5a,b ).
